pattern.description: Keyboard-style selection hop in the emoji grid: the highlight ring and warm fill jump in a single frame from the peeking-eye tile to the fire tile, while the whole grid keeps a slow leftward drift.
pattern.why_premium: The focus change is an instant, honest UI step (no tween), set against a continuous slow drift, so the shot reads as real product behaviour while still feeling cinematic; the orange ring is the only saturated accent, pulling the eye straight to the new selection.

build_hint.gsap: Continuous drift: gsap.to('.grid', {x: '-=36', duration: 2, ease: 'none'}). Selection hop: tl.set('.tile.peek', {className: 'tile'}).set('.tile.fire', {className: 'tile selected'}) (instant; selected = 4px orange border + warm fill).
build_hint.remotion: Grid translateX = interpolate(frame, [0, 60], [0, -36], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) (linear). Selected index = frame >= hopFrame ? fireIndex : peekIndex; apply ring/fill styles from the selected index with no interpolation.

notes: Energy spike at the 4th burst frame is the one-frame selection hop; the rising tail is the slow grid drift (camera verdict none, pan_x small). Only the fire tile ring is unambiguous; whether the middle tile had a ring before the hop is visible in frame f431 (pale ring) so it is listed as losing focus.
